description: Figure 7 illustrates the comparison of accuracy for Ex1 and Ex2 during the embedding and LM head training stage. The x-axis is labeled “Step”, has a linear scale, ranges from 0 to 60000, and has tick labels at intervals of 10000. The y-axis is labeled “Accuracy”, has a linear scale, ranges from 0.20 to 0.40, and has tick labels at intervals of 0.05.  A blue solid line represents Ex1 Accuracy, starting at approximately 0.23 at Step 0 and ending at approximately 0.36 at Step 60000, with a generally increasing trend and a plateau between Steps 20000 and 40000 where the value remains around 0.34. An orange dashed line represents Ex2 Accuracy, starting at approximately 0.25 at Step 0 and ending at approximately 0.38 at Step 60000, also with a generally increasing trend and a plateau between Steps 20000 and 40000 where the value remains around 0.35.
